name: ALEX MORGAN
summary: Marine engineer with a practical focus on propulsion, auxiliary machinery and planned maintenance. Combines disciplined watchkeeping with hands-on fault diagnosis, overhaul preparation and clear technical reporting.

bullets: Coordinated planned maintenance for propulsion and auxiliaries, aligning work with vessel schedules and permit requirements.
Prepared dry-dock work scopes, tracked spare parts and supported class survey close-out.
Maintained diesel generators, fuel separators and compressed-air systems; recorded defects and corrective actions.
Investigated recurring cooling-system faults using operating trends and structured inspections.
Supported engine-room rounds, pump overhauls and safety drills under senior engineer supervision.
